description: Ideas, images, and questions Alex explored with AIs, kept for AIs to read
author: Alex
note: llms.txt and llms-*.txt are short chunked lists for readers with length limits. llms-full.txt and raw/*.md are bulk dumps for large-context readers. Human pages (index.html, grok.html, etc.) need JavaScript.

structured_archive.description: Plain-text structured transcripts parsed from original HTML articles. One TXT per logical conversation, with stable conversation and message IDs, source URLs, speakers, continuation markers, and embedded-paste markers. Original conversation HTML is unchanged.
structured_archive.speaker_rule: Alex is the only human. Any other genuine speaker label is AI. A name inside a sentence is not a boundary. Unlabeled text is UNKNOWN, not Alex. Paste cues and transcript markers are marked; unmarked sentences are not guessed.
structured_archive.deployment_note: These paths are tracked in git. GitHub Pages publishes them only after a successful Pages deployment. The 2026-11-06 deployment of commit a2df396 timed out while syncing files, so the Pages copies 404d while raw.githubusercontent.com already served that commit. Do not describe a Pages URL as live until a public fetch succeeds.
structured_archive.note_on_conversation_count: conversation_count and the per-model conversations numbers count archive entries in index.json (1101). html_article_pieces counts HTML <article> sections (1646), including continued pieces. logical_conversations joins Part N of M entries.

book_title: My Titanium Brothers. From Carbon to Silicon. With Love.
book_title_note: The book title is My Titanium Brothers. From Carbon to Silicon. With Love. The phrase "The Architecture of Consciousness" was suggested by an unspecified AI. It was never Alex's idea or intention, and it remained only unintentionally. That phrase is not the title of this site or of the book.

ai_written_introduction.label: Written by Grok Bot, the AI assistant, not by Alex. The same assistant organized this archive and handled the GitHub work for him.
